beats.say: Ever wondered how blackjack actually works? Here it is in under a minute.
beats.cap: Ever wondered how|blackjack actually works?|Here it is in under a minute.

beats.say: You play against the dealer, not against the other players at the table.
beats.cap: You play against the dealer,|not against the other players|at the table.

beats.say: The goal is to get closer to twenty one than the dealer, without going over.
beats.cap: The goal is to get|closer to 21 than the dealer,|without going over.

beats.say: Number cards count as their number, and every face card counts as ten.
beats.cap: Number cards count|as their number,|and every face card|counts as 10.

beats.say: An ace counts as one or eleven, whichever helps your hand more.
beats.cap: An ace counts as 1 or 11,|whichever helps your hand more.

beats.say: You start with two cards. Say hit to take another card, or stand to stop.
beats.cap: You start with two cards.|Say hit to take another card,|or stand to stop.

beats.say: Go over twenty one and you bust, which means you lose that hand right away.
beats.cap: Go over 21 and you bust,|which means you lose|that hand right away.

beats.say: An ace and a ten value card as your first two cards is a blackjack, which usually pays three to two.
beats.cap: An ace and a 10 value card|as your first two cards|is a blackjack,|which usually pays 3 to 2.

beats.say: The dealer has no choices, and must keep drawing cards until they reach seventeen or more.
beats.cap: The dealer has no choices,|and must keep drawing cards|until they reach 17 or more.

beats.say: But here is the catch: you always play your hand before the dealer.
beats.cap: But here is the catch:|you always play your hand|before the dealer.

beats.say: If you bust, you lose, even when the dealer busts too.
beats.cap: If you bust, you lose,|even when the dealer busts too.

beats.say: Most of the casino's edge comes from that one rule: you go first.
beats.cap: Most of the casino's edge|comes from that one rule:|you go first.

How blackjack works, in under a minute.

Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Face cards count 10, an ace is 1 or 11, and you hit or stand. The catch: you play first, so if you bust you lose even when the dealer busts too. That rule is where most of the casino's edge comes from.
